text:
deploy-bot: starting staged rollout v2.4.1 -> 5% traffic in eu-west & ap-south. changelist: kv-cache pin, kernel tweak, image digest pinned. start 18:21 UTC. stop/go in 10m. release notes: https://company.internal/releases/v2.4.1 :rocket:

alice: @deploy-bot ack. release notes look good. are we pinning runtime digest or image tag?

ben: pinned digest: sha256:7a9b3f4c... and pinned model variant compat-2.3 for fallback. prewarming 2 nodes in both regions. :thumbsup:

carla: seeing a small spike of 502s in eu-west at ~18:23 UTC — tail latency up ~120ms for some edges. error rate ~0.3% but trending. sample logs: ```[edge] 18:23:12 injector->upstream: 502 downstream timeout, kvcache miss```

jeff: can we isolate to eu-west and reduce rollout there to 2% while ap-south continues at 5%? prefer hold in eu-west until we see stable telemetry. :eyes:

alice: +1 hold eu-west at 2%, continue ap-south. tagging oncall. @dave are you available?

dave: oncall here, looking now. I'll pin eu-west route to compat fallback and drain v2.4.1 there. give me 5m to apply pinned route and confirm.

ben: running runbook step 3 (route pin + drain). command: `infractl route set --region eu-west --version compat-2.3.8 --weight 100%`

deploy-bot: action taken: eu-west weight for v2.4.1 set to 2% then rolled back to 0% and routed to compat-2.3.8 as of 18:27 UTC. ap-south remains at 5%. notify: next check in 10m. :white_check_mark:

carla: after pin, eu-west error rate back to baseline within ~90s. keeping an eye on tail. :relieved:

alice: thanks team. we'll document rationale in release notes and schedule a follow-up postmortem if needed. tagging release docs. :memo: 

jeff: recommendation: add an autoscale knob to prewarm 1 extra replica during canary to smooth kvcache misses. filed as infra ticket #INF-982.

deploy-bot: noted. thread will be archived after final check.
